The Safeguard Instruments are defined as the environmental and social impact assessment and the Abbreviated Resettlement Action Plan, both dated 27 November 2010 and published on 6 January 2011, the resettlement plan being the one prepared for Part D.2 of the project, "Construction of a regional office for the land sector agencies in Kumasi", to deal with "any adverse social and economic impacts on Displaced Persons as a result of their displacement" (Appendix, definitions 1 and 23). The agreement also required Ghana to run the project under a Project Implementation Manual it could not amend or waive if the Bank thought the change might materially and adversely affect the project, and to get the Bank's approval of an annual work plan and budget each December (Section 2.03.B and E).

why.safeguard: "ensure that all measures required for carrying out the recommendations of the Safeguard Instruments are taken in a timely manner"
why.admin: to get the Bank's approval of an annual work plan and budget each December

kumasi-lands-office-farmers-displaced.searched: The financing agreement for Credit 4870-GH of 15 June 2011 is not in the Bank's archive, and the two published amendments to it change only the spending categories and closing date. Found and read instead the co-financing grant agreement for Trust Fund TF014256, one of the project's own financiers, which carries the covenant and names the Kumasi resettlement plan.

kamuzu-barrage-liwonde-businesses.conditions_add: The financing agreement for Credit 5125-MW and Grant H775-MW, dated 22 August 2012, carried a dated obligation about the dams built or upgraded under the project, among them the Kamuzu Barrage. The amendment letter of 11 August 2017 replaced it with a new Section I.E.6 of Schedule 2 requiring Malawi to furnish the Association, by 1 September 2018 or the date 95 per cent of the financing was disbursed, whichever came first, with "operational procedures with respect to the dams constructed or upgraded under the Project, including retention of written instructions for flood operations and emergency preparedness at such dams at all times", along with changes to the dam safety criteria as new technology or information arrived and the application of those revised criteria to the project's dams and others under Malawi's jurisdiction. The same letter set the closing date at 31 January 2019 and reallocated the money between spending categories.

why.safeguard: "operational procedures with respect to the dams constructed or upgraded under the Project, including retention of written instructions for flood operations and emergency preparedness at such dams at all times"

kamuzu-barrage-liwonde-businesses.searched: The financing agreement of 22 August 2012 itself is not in the Bank's archive, which for this project holds only the appraisal documents, completion reports, resettlement plans, procurement plans and audits. dennery-embankment-land-used-without-com.conditions_add: The Dennery coastal protection works were built under the 2004 loan and credit for the Second Disaster Management Project, whose loan agreement for Loan 7238-LC required Saint Lucia, "prior to the approval of any proposed civil work(s) to be financed out of the proceeds of the Loan", to apply the Environmental Management Plan of 9 March 2004 by carrying out an environmental screening and assessment of the works and preparing recommendations for preventing, mitigating and remedying any potential environmental damage, and then, during the works, to have those recommendations carried out (Article III, Section 3.08). The credit agreement for Credit 3936-LC incorporates that article and applies it to the credit (Article III, Section 3.01). The 2008 additional financing agreement for Credit 4498-LC repeats the same requirement (Schedule 2, Section I.C); neither agreement sets any requirement about land acquisition, resettlement or compensation, and the words do not appear in either text.

why.safeguard: to apply the Environmental Management Plan of 9 March 2004 by carrying out an environmental screening and assessment of the works
